projects.name: Not Verified

Free waitlist of 2,000 shares for 7 days only (1,000 Agent ID lane + 1,000 verified-blue X lane) through a 5-step task ladder with an EIP-712 permit gate and the X handle burned on-chain after one claim. Paid side: 5,000 shares on a paid-only staircase (0.0005 BNB, +0.00005 per 10 paid shares, cap 0.01), 80% of every payment into the PancakeSwap pool in the same transaction (LP burned), referral 1 bonus share per 3 paid. Sell tax 2%, buys untaxed. Zero owner allocation, no admin.
